news.headline: Marathon Runners Celebrate a 50th Anniversary
news.body: On November 1, Sheila Chepkirui of Kenya won the women's race at the New York City Marathon. She ran the 26.2 miles in two hours and 24 minutes! This year was the 50th anniversary of the course, which winds through all five boroughs: Staten Island, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Manhattan.

news.headline: A 9-Year-Old Is TIME's Kid of the Year
news.body: Ledger Mann, age 9, was named TIME's 2026 Kid of the Year. He helps first responders learn how to care for kids with autism, and he helps other neurodivergent kids feel understood. An editor said Ledger's ability to thrive at school and with friends is admirable.
